justification: Both surfaces bear cuneiform inscriptions, but A is an inscribed surface filled edge-to-edge with dense script and no figural content, while B is a narrow text band flanked and bordered by figural and decorative elements (a hand, fringed garment edge, floral/rosette motifs). The presence of figural/ornamental framing in B with no counterpart in A is the major difference, while the shared cuneiform text is a very generic correspondence common to many such inscribed surfaces.
